about: Speed lab baseline (tests/amiga/run_fsuae_netbench.sh): FS-UAE 3.2.35 with the tools/fs-uae libpcap bridge, AROS ROM, veth; KB/s of emulated time. a1200-020 and a4000-040: the send path work of 23 October 2026 (branch p5-txpath); a1200-030 and a4000-060: main d814867 (22 October 2026), not rerun. See docs/COMPARISON.md section 11.

not_measured.amitcp: AmiTCP 3.0b2 crashes the AROS ROM when a program opens its bsdsocket.library; needs KICKSTART= (a real Kickstart ROM)
not_measured.roadshow: the demo needs AmigaOS 3.x (a real Kickstart and Workbench)
not_measured.miami: the evaluation version needs Kickstart 2.04+, MUI and its GUI
